rationale: The buyer is a specific, named business role — IT admin or MSP managing Microsoft 365 tenants — with a hard vendor deadline (Feb 1, 2027) creating genuine urgency and non-optional spend. Willingness to pay is credible: these buyers already hold M365 licenses and routinely purchase compliance tooling. Buildability is strong: a Claude-powered migration readiness checker (questionnaire → analysis → tailored runbook PDF) is shippable in a week. Operational autonomy just clears the build gate at 7, but responsiveness_signal is untested (3), so validate first with a simple landing page and outreach to IT admin communities before committing to build.
solution_plan: The micro-service is an M365 MFA Migration Readiness Checker: an IT admin fills out a short intake form (current MFA methods, conditional access policies, device types, user count) and receives a tailored migration runbook PDF within minutes, generated by Claude. To build: the factory creates a Claude prompt that maps intake answers to Microsoft's documented migration paths, a simple web form (Tally or Typeform), a Stripe payment link (~$49-$99 one-time), and an automated email delivery of the PDF report — no coding by the operator. To sell: post in r/sysadmin, MSP-focused Slack groups, and Spiceworks forums; outreach drafts go to the operator for approval before sending. To maintain: intake → Claude → PDF → email is fully automated; billing is Stripe; the only recurring operator touch is approving outreach batches and reviewing the occasional edge-case question flagged by Claude. Validate first with a free 'quick assessment' offer to 20 IT admins to confirm they'll pay for the full report.
notes: operational_autonomy at 7 meets the build gate floor exactly — marginal pass. responsiveness_signal untested (3). Recommend validate stage: run a lightweight outreach probe to IT admin communities before building. No failing build gates, but the marginal autonomy score and zero responsiveness data make validation the right next step.
